instruction: A blocky toy knight figure snapped together from plastic bricks, with a cylindrical helmet, printed chest-plate torso, and clip-on gray sword and shield. Its stud-topped rectangular limbs and C-clip hands have the glossy molded finish of a buildable minifigure.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Brick Knight in a LEGO-like brick style. A blocky toy knight figure snapped together from plastic bricks, with a cylindrical helmet, printed chest-plate torso, and clip-on gray sword and shield. Its stud-topped rectangular limbs and C-clip hands have the glossy molded finish of a buildable minifigure. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
